source_agreement.note: Hash of locally extracted text; not asserted original upload bytes

scope: U only; no O injection; descriptive evidence and research protocol, not calibrated strategy

engines.C: Japan/Korea indices and FX, Asian opening
engines.F: policy execution, first-party business information, industry opinion, personal/social sentiment

speech_rules.Trump: policy reversal/TACO risk; executed policy separate from statement
speech_rules.Jensen_Altman: verifiable operating data versus industry views

forbidden_inferences: today archive download => historical PIT proof
current U45 or O660 => historical universe
status_of_reference_bands: Inherited proposed ranges; not fitted/validated; do not apply a position from incomplete engines

out_of_time.calendar: actual verified HK trading sessions, not weekdays
out_of_time.twenty_sessions: operational preliminary check, not statistical proof

fill_contract.earliest: after report availability; no historical/current-close retroactive fills
fill_contract.overlap: do not duplicate positions or capital
fill_contract.same_bar_stop_and_profit: unknown or explicitly conservative; no optimistic ordering
fill_contract.costs: include brokerage, exchange/levies/stamp duty, slippage/currency; unknown != zero

baseline: HSI on same dates and return basis
O and U as different systems, not pure algorithm comparison

factor_promotion: none; requires evidence and user-approved specific change
deployment: manual only; no scheduler, orders, or notifications enabled
